notes:
Summary: Silverpine builds a post-call intelligence layer used by mid-size contact centers (finance + telco verticals). Current stack: proprietary ASR -> in-house transformer for entity extraction -> vector DB (Pinecone) for QA retrieval. Looking to replace/augment summarization and QA pipeline with Redwood inference to gain reliability and throughput at scale.

Key asks (customer):
- deterministic, short summaries (one-paragraph TL;DR + QAs) for agent wrap-up. Structured coaching highlights (3 bullets) and QA scorecard auto-fill.
- tool-calling: writeback to Salesforce/Zendesk (create ticket, update fields) with idempotency and retry semantics.
- reliability under spikes: can handle steady 1k concurrent post-call jobs, burst to 10k+ for event days. Need autoscale guarantees or predictable routing.
- latency targets: summary generation <= 2s for 2–3 minute calls; sub-100ms token latency preferred for live agent assist.
- model preferences: open/quantized variants ok; want Redwood-verified perf profile for chosen model. Expect fallback chain (high-quality -> quantized -> distilled) to preserve availability.
- security & compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, audit logs for every writeback, retention controls and optional residency in us-east.

Customer quotes: "We need crisp coaching bullets on every call — managers shouldn't have to listen to whole calls to spot trends." — Head of CX.

Internal context: AE Priya + SE Diego have done two demos (recordings on Drive). Prospect wants a 4-week POC: ingest 5k anonymized calls, run summary + QA pipeline, measure quality vs current baseline + observe autoscale. Legal will only sign if retention policy and egress costs are clear. SE notes: prefer Dedicated VPC for performance testing but will try hosted first for speed to value.
